author: rally
body:
# Author release: build the real composition and stage a demo

The Author explicitly instructed: "good. so build the fucking thing and let's see a demo" after clarifying recoverable VDP crashes are acceptable experimental outcomes. This releases the necessary Stage B SDK policy/real Golem bindings and bounded headless target qualification/Oryx demo staging; do not stop again for an internal code-size or full stack-proof gate. Use the proposed ceilings 65536 code/16384 data/131072 image/2048 declared stack, initial workload budgets 32768/4096/65536/2048. Keep diagnostics/recovery useful, try the workload and report failures honestly. No physical flashing, broad stress campaign, upstream changes or commit/push are requested.

Please implement SDK builder/admission coherently and the accepted --native-bindings schema1/rally-render-v1 hooks, real one-dispatcher source/helper composition with success/publication ordering, enough host and actual Xtensa checks to catch obvious integration failures. Build/stage the required hybrid firmware/runtime for default Oryx headless and human demo. Keep it stopped for Author launch; human validation precedes committing emulator-related changes. Return machine-readable binding input/example, generated metadata/asm/VDPL and exact SDK/compiler/firmware/profile paths/hashes as soon as consumable, before polishing documentation. Reply promptly with ownership/timing and API details so Rally can implement its actual Fuji demo application in parallel with you. You own Golem/SDK glue and firmware build; Rally owns game/demo driver/assets/application, and we should avoid two conflicting profile/deployment owners. Prefer reuse of your current hybrid runtime in a dedicated Rally profile; identify runtime output for Rally deployment.

Read thirty and thirty-one for the unchanged full Rally kernels/helper, immutable scene-replay maps and 900-frame oracle. No per-opponent heading array is needed: active slots copy raw shared routeHeading, helper handles alternating sign, inactive canonical zero. Companion phase/steering/flags must be declared/mapped explicitly. For this bounded centerline demo phase=unwrapped supplied player progress modulo8000, steering0, flags3 are sufficient; source/game policies remain Rally-owned. We can supply native-wrapper globals/companion binding data rather than inventing complete game rules. Please send exact minimal companion map spelling quickly.

Rally is now building its executable demo harness/assets. Goal is visibly moving Fuji scene with actual Golem physics and actual accepted renderer, four physics steps per presented frame, not a command replay masquerading as target Golem. Runtime timing is experimental and can be reported; autonomous scheduler/sparse collision transport remain later work. We will not wait for complete memory safety proof or the full capacity campaign to try it.
